$comment: The whole payload of `run.accept` and `run.lease_renew`, contract 1.11.0 (ADR 0029). Shared the way session-id.schema.json is shared: both messages say only 'this run', and giving each its own copy would be two places to forget a constraint. Both are one-way frames — the daemon sends them and nothing answers, so there is nowhere for an extra field to be read.
